name: Eptazocine
summary: Eptazocine (Sedapain) is an opioid analgesic which was introduced in Japan by Morishita in 1987. It acts as a mixed κ-opioid receptor agonist and μ-opioid receptor antagonist.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a mixed κ-opioid receptor agonist and μ-opioid receptor antagonist.

summaryZh: 依他佐辛（英語：Eptazocine，商品名：Sedapain）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C15H21NO，屬於苯嗎喃衍生物，可作為類阿片鎮痛藥。常以氫溴酸鹽的形式給藥，用於癌症和術後患者鎮痛。由日本醫藥品工業株式會社（今日醫工株式會社）開發，1987年獲得厚生省批准在日本上市銷售。
